mathematics.assertion_tested: At ell=2,3,4 and three listed tolerances, regular n=1 TF radial Helmholtz ODE boundary response agrees with the Bessel solution; direct quadrupole integration agrees with derived C; declared benchmark SI conversions and scale ratios are computed.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: IEEE double precision scipy 1.11.4; analytic derivation in accompanying note
mathematics.conventions: rho=m|psi|²; Qij=integral rho (xi xj-deltaij r²/3); Eij=STF Hessian U; Qij=-lambda_T Eij; k=1/L
inputs: ell in [2,3,4], rtol in [1e-9,1e-11,1e-13], x in [1e-5,pi]
unit constants and comparison lengths exactly listed in inputs.json
non_claims: No universal acceleration response or a0 selection
No relativistic or complete nonperturbative phase classification
